title: Medieval settlement time-lapse | Godot / GPT 6 / Fable 5.2
author: 2nd_breakfastt
selftext:
I wanted to share an example of what building a town looks like in my game! It is one of the many different ways you can choose to live in the world of Valdmark

Simulation took about 30 mins to run at 4x speed. All footage is in game footage with ui turned off 

GPT-6 was used for brainstorming, game design, planning mechanics, and creating art references. Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.2 handled the coding, implementing gameplay systems, and procedurally generating the artwork. The game itself is build in Godot, with blender used to generate 3D models and assets 

Demo on itch https://ynotved.itch.io/valdmark
